notes.title: Award-winning at the German children's media festival “Goldener Spatz”
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317192/a8124d74338e0a3bd1e93729dce553e64975c322.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Rascal's Escape[/b] won in the [b]“Interactive & Digital Storytelling” category[/b] at the [b]German children's media festival “Goldener Spatz”[/b]. During the festival, the audience was able to test the game extensively. On June 6, the children's jury met in Erfurt and awarded Rascal's Escape the prize in the category for interactive media formats[/p]

notes.title: Rascal’s Escape is nominated for the German Children’s Software Award! 🎉🐿️🐻
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317192/e10b551f5f53499ca0104ed2d2b882ef3fa1abb6.jpg[/img]

Exciting news: Rascal’s Escape is nominated for the TOMMI 2024, the German Children’s Software Award! 🎉🐿️🐻

Our cooperative adventure game is in the running for two categories:

⭐️ ⁠Rascal’s Escape in the Education category
⭐️ ⁠Rascal’s Escape in the PC category

You can watch the awards ceremony on Sunday, December 1, 2024, at 8 PM (CEST) on the media magazine “Team Timster” on KiKA (a german tv channel for kids).

Wish us luck! 🤞
